description: A link to Etapa's sign-in page, where the rider signs in with Google, Apple or an email and password (or creates their account) and lets this chat in. The way to sign in; `etapa_send_code` only if they can't open a link. Never ask for a password in the chat. Only after they have agreed to all four agreements in `etapa_signup_questions`. Give them the link as it is, then call `etapa_finish_sign_in`.
name: etapa_sign_in_link
title: Etapa sign-up: sign in on Etapa's page
